post.description:
Addition (P1, streaming chat): the same checked turn, with progress events while it runs.

Events: `status` (what the agent is doing), `tool` (each broker decision as
it happens), then one `reply` (the full ChatReply, after the grounding
check) or `error`. Text is never streamed before it is checked.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: Addition: ids of the message's threat signals.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Addition: how many review flags the turn raised.

review_status.title: Review Status
review_status.description: Addition: open, cleared or escalated; null if not flagged.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Addition: the tool results behind the reply, as cards.

number_sources.title: Number Sources
number_sources.description: Addition: the source of each figure in the reply.

provenance.description: Addition: the reply's AI label and fingerprints.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Shown to the compliance role only.

changed_by.title: Changed By
changed_by.description: Shown to the compliance role only.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Addition: the measured value against the rule's limit, pass or fail.

content_sha256.title: Content Sha256
content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of this report without this field, for the record.

ModelCardGovernance.title: ModelCardGovernance
ModelCardGovernance.description: Addition: how the AI's output is labelled, fingerprinted, screened, traced and reviewed.

NumberSource.title: NumberSource
NumberSource.description: Addition: where one figure in the reply came from, by its character span in the reply.

config_fingerprint.title: Config Fingerprint
config_fingerprint.description: Addition: the configuration fingerprint replies are tagged with.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Addition: conditions in the log that need attention.

threat_turns.title: Threat Turns
threat_turns.description: Addition: turns whose message raised a medium or high threat signal.

reviews_open.title: Reviews Open
reviews_open.description: Addition: flagged turns not yet cleared or escalated.

feedback_down.title: Feedback Down
feedback_down.description: Addition: replies a client marked unhelpful.

median_shortfall.title: Median Shortfall
median_shortfall.description: Median gap to the target in the paths that miss it.

required_monthly.title: Required Monthly
required_monthly.description: Monthly contribution needed for a 50%, 75% and 90% chance of reaching the target.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Addition: why the engine (or the client) chose this product, in plain words.

ProposalPreview.title: ProposalPreview
ProposalPreview.description: A dry run of a revision: the same engines and gate, nothing saved.

label.title: Label
label.description: The visible label: AI-generated, Automated template (checked) or System notice.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that served the reply, when the model answered.

config_fingerprint.title: Config Fingerprint
config_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the configuration that produced the reply.

content_sha256.title: Content Sha256
content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reply text exactly as shown.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
Addition: the explicit and machine-readable label on every reply (China's AI-content labelling measures,
EU AI Act Art. 50). The same facts travel in the X-AI-Generated and X-AI-Content-SHA256 response headers.

Remedy.title: Remedy
Remedy.description: The smallest change that gets the proposal through the gate, computed by code (a counterfactual explanation).

RemedyCard.title: RemedyCard
RemedyCard.description: Addition: the suggest_fix tool's result; the client applies it with one click.

events.title: Events
events.description: Addition: what happened in the world during the episode.

events_label.title: Events Label
events_label.description: Addition: says the events are real and the portfolio path illustrative.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Addition: the regulatory requirement each rule is designed to meet.

TraceSpan.title: TraceSpan
TraceSpan.description: One step of a turn, named after the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions.

TurnDetail.title: TurnDetail
TurnDetail.description: Addition: everything about one AI turn, for the Control Room's turn inspector.
